attribution.dataset: Jiang, X., Dai, C., Liu, X., & Fan, J. (2023). Open Access Dataset and Toolbox of High-Density Surface Electromyogram Recordings (version 2.0.0). PhysioNet.
attribution.produced_work: Contains models derived from the Hyser 2.0.0 Random dataset, made available by PhysioNet under ODC-By 1.0.

interpretation.aligned_comparison_sign: A positive paired delta favors aligned surface EMG
interpretation.findings: Aligned EMG did not improve aggregate MAE over force history in nested person-held-out TRAIN or locked person-held-out DEV.
interpretation.primary_metric: Participant-macro mean absolute error, with each day contributing equally within participant
interpretation.secondary_metric: Participant-macro root mean square error, with each day contributing equally within participant
interpretation.setting: Self-selected isometric finger contractions, one index transducer compared to raw surface EMG in Hyser Random.
interpretation.timing: Trace lookahead on the nominal released grid. Exact upstream force phase and causal availability are unverified. No live or physiological lead time measured.
interpretation.uncertainty: Descriptive participant-resampling percentiles and leave-one-person-out mean range. Four independent people in DEV. Windows within the same participant are not independent.

target: released Hyser 2.0.0 index force transducer voltage
